name: CreateProhibitedPolicy

parameters.help_en: Policy Name of the prohibited software policy. Policy Name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Spaces are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 软件禁用策略名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-），不支持空格
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the prohibited software policy. The description can be up to 128 characters in length and can be empty
parameters.help_zh: 软件禁用策略描述。长度不超过128个字符，允许为空
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The action to take. Valid values:
Ban: blocks the software from running and displays a pop-up window on the terminal to notify the user.
BanSilent: blocks the software from running without notifying the user.
Warn: displays a pop-up window on the terminal to notify the user without blocking the software from running
parameters.help_zh:
处置动作。取值：
Ban：禁止运行并在终端弹窗提醒终端用户。
BanSilent：禁止运行且不提醒终端用户，静默阻断。
Warn：仅在终端弹窗提醒终端用户，不阻断软件运行
parameters.name: policy_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the policy is enabled. Valid values:
true: The policy is enabled, delivered to terminals, and takes effect.
false: The policy is disabled. The configuration is retained but not delivered to terminals
parameters.help_zh:
策略是否启用。取值：
true：启用，策略会下发到终端并生效。
false：停用，策略保留配置但不下发到终端
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The list of exempted usernames
parameters.help_zh: 例外用户名列表
parameters.name: whitelist

parameters.help_en: The Chinese prompt content in the terminal pop-up window
parameters.help_zh: 终端弹窗的中文提示内容
parameters.name: prompt_ch

parameters.help_en: The English prompt content in the terminal pop-up window
parameters.help_zh: 终端弹窗的英文提示内容
parameters.name: prompt_en

parameters.help_en: The policy priority. Valid values: 0 to 99. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 策略优先级。取值范围：0~99，数值越小优先级越高
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The object type. Valid values:
App: controls disable software. The managed objects are specified by SoftwareIds.
Tag: controls disable software labels. The managed objects are specified by TagIds. All disable software within the labels is managed
parameters.help_zh:
管控对象类型。取值：
App：按禁用软件管控，管控对象由SoftwareIds指定。
Tag：按禁用软件标签管控，管控对象由TagIds指定，标签内的全部禁用软件均被管控
parameters.name: object_type

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the prohibited software is built-in. Valid values:
true: The software is built-in, shared by all Alibaba Cloud accounts, and cannot be modified or deleted.
false: The software is custom prohibited software under the current Alibaba Cloud account
fields.help_zh:
该禁用软件是否为系统内置禁用软件。取值：
true：系统内置禁用软件，所有阿里云账号共享，不支持修改和删除。
false：当前阿里云账号下的自定义禁用软件
fields.name: is_default

fields.help_en:
The ID of the prohibited software. You can obtain the value from the following sources:
[ListProhibitedSoftware](~~ListProhibitedSoftware~~): queries prohibited software in batches.
[CreateProhibitedSoftware](~~CreateProhibitedSoftware~~): creates custom prohibited software
fields.help_zh:
禁用软件ID。取值来源：
[ListProhibitedSoftware](~~ListProhibitedSoftware~~)：批量查询禁用软件。
[CreateProhibitedSoftware](~~CreateProhibitedSoftware~~)：创建自定义禁用软件
fields.name: software_id

parameters.help_en: The collection of prohibited software directly managed by the policy
parameters.help_zh: 该策略直接管控的禁用软件集合
parameters.name: software_ids

parameters.help_en: The collection of prohibited software tag IDs managed by the policy
parameters.help_zh: 该策略管控的禁用软件标签ID集合
parameters.name: tag_ids

parameters.help_en:
The effective scope. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: The policy takes effect for all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify user groups.
UserGroupNormal: The policy takes effect only for users in the user groups specified by UserGroupIds
parameters.help_zh:
生效范围。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效，不需要指定用户组。
UserGroupNormal：仅对UserGroupIds指定的用户组内的用户生效
parameters.name: match_mode

parameters.help_en: The collection of user group IDs for which the policy takes effect
parameters.help_zh: 策略生效的用户组ID集合
parameters.name: user_group_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow terminal users to submit an exception request for the policy. Valid values:
true: Exception requests are allowed. The terminal pop-up window provides an entry for the request.
false: Exception requests are not allowed
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许终端用户对该策略发起报备申请。取值：
true：允许报备，终端弹窗提供报备入口。
false：不允许报备
parameters.name: allow_report

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to forcibly terminate running processes of the software. Valid values:
true: The terminal immediately terminates the running processes of the software when the policy is matched.
false: The terminal does not terminate running processes but only prevents subsequent startups
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制结束已运行的软件进程。取值：
true：终端在命中策略时立即结束该软件正在运行的进程。
false：不结束已运行的进程，仅阻止后续启动
parameters.name: force_kill
